name: Mines
description: A mine-finding puzzle in a panel, to play while Claude works. Five boards from 9×9 to 30×16, a safe first click, flags (right-click or a Flag mode), opening around a number, keyboard play, and your best time per board. When a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you, the game pauses and names that tab, with a button to go to it. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session, runs nothing and uses no network.
author: BronOS
